title: The Escalator Problem: Identifying Implicit Motion Blindness in AI for Accessibility

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) using the 'Escalator Problem' (identifying the direction of a moving escalator from video) to demonstrate their reliance on static frame-sampling paradigms and their inability to process continuous, low-signal temporal motion.

Assessing how the technical inability of AI models to perceive implicit motion translates into critical functional failures for assistive navigation tools, thereby disproportionately compromising the safety, cognitive load, and independence of the blind and visually impaired (BVI) community.
